title: Bind consequential evidence to exact current state
summary: Consequential decisions must bind to the exact current protected state rather than historical membership or stale evidence.
problem_pattern: A valid historical commit, check, review or cache entry is reused after the protected tip or candidate head has changed.
failure_mode: Stale evidence can be mistaken for current authorization or gate satisfaction.
root_cause: Identity and freshness are checked separately or incompletely instead of binding repository, base and exact head together.
prevention_rule: Reconcile live facts and require all consequential CI, review, approval and promotion evidence to bind to the same exact repository/base/head tuple.
preflight_checks: reconcile live repository and protected-branch state
compare exact base and head identities across CI and review evidence
reject historical or stale evidence after any head movement
regression_tests: exact-head evidence mismatch must fail closed
applicability_notes: Generic for protected-state, CI, review and promotion decisions.
